description: Level 10: preference. Lower level numbers win.

rules.rationale: The hash backend needs nothing and is deterministic. Switch to ollama or sentence-transformers when you want better recall.
auto tries a keyed backend, then DuckDuckGo, then the fixture index. It never fails because of a missing key.
Plain text in the terminal; --json on any command when a script is reading it.
The output is read in a terminal, a log and a diff. Emoji break two of those three.
Long answers get skimmed. The citations are there when more is needed.
